thread:
noah: Hey team, first on-call tomorrow AM. Two quick things: I can’t view infra runbooks (403) and my PD notifications aren’t reaching my phone. who to ping?
rachel: welcome! ping @ops-admin for Confluence spaces. For PD notifications check that you enabled mobile push and verified phone in profile.
ops-admin: added noah to Infra Runbooks. PD notification logs show delivery attempted but bounced for SMS. Can you check Push is enabled?
noah: Push was off, turned it on and got a test ping. Runbook still 403 though.
rachel: try clearing cookies or use SSO incognito. If still 403, ops-admin can add you to the group.
ops-admin: gave view access to Infra Runbooks. Confirmed. Also added you to the on-call rota calendar.
oncall-bot: Reminder: shadow slots available today 15:00 and 16:00 UTC. Join the oncall-shadow meeting for walk-throughs.
noah: thanks! one more quick procedure q: minimal PD ack/escalation timings?
rachel: ACK within 15m. If alert is P1 or system-wide latency >2x, immediate ack and open incident channel. Capture PD id, recent logs (rdw-logs), and p95 charts before escalating.
noah: perfect, I’ll join 16:00 shadow. thanks all :thumbsup:
